title: memo["meta"] of an SManga
description: Structured details of a series, stored under the "meta" key of SManga.memo next to the plain fields that show the same facts. A few typed keys serve searching, sorting and filtering; everything to display goes into "sections", blocks in the order the source lists them. Every key except "v" is optional and left out when unknown. Keys added later keep "v"; readers ignore keys and block types they don't know. The same object on an SChapter follows #/$defs/chapter.

v.description: Layout version. Changes only when an existing key changes meaning or shape.

altTitles.description: Other titles of the series, in any language or script, without the title itself.

rating.description: The site's rating as it gives it.

value.description: The rating, on the scale 0 to "max".

max.description: Top of the scale, e.g. 5, 10 or 100.

contentRating.description: Audience the site rates the series for.

primaryTags.description: The site's genres or main categories, when SManga.genre also holds other tags.

trackers.description: The series' ids on trackers, keyed by tracker, e.g. {"anilist": "30002", "myanimelist": "2"}. Known keys: anilist, myanimelist, kitsu, mangaupdates (base-36 id, or the old numeric one), animeplanet (slug), mangabaka, shikimori, novelupdates (slug).

sections.description: What to display, as blocks in order.

fields.description: Label and value rows, e.g. type, year, publisher, views.

summary.description: A short fact fit for a one-line overview (type, year, language).

titles.description: A list of titles under a label, e.g. alternative names.

chips.description: Short values under a label, e.g. a group of the site's tags.

search.description: Each value is a search term for the source.

collapsed.description: Values the site tucks away, e.g. behind "more".

spoiler.description: Values the site marks as spoilers.

links.description: Links under a label, e.g. databases, the original publication, official translations (each labelled with its language), stores.

text.description: A paragraph of Markdown, in the same dialect as SManga.description.

language.description: BCP 47 language tag, e.g. ja, ko, zh-Hans, es-419.

chapter.title: memo["meta"] of an SChapter
chapter.description: Structured details of a chapter, under the "meta" key of SChapter.memo. Every key except "v" is optional.

locked.description: The site serves the chapter's pages only after a purchase, a login or a wait. Left out when false.

volume.description: Volume the chapter belongs to, as the site writes it.

scanlators.description: Every group credited, when SChapter.scanlator joins several.

language.description: Language of the chapter, when the source mixes languages.
